THIS_IS_A_WITHIN_FAMILY_TABLE: This is a WITHIN-FAMILY table. The 17 finished harvests span only Qwen3 and TinyLlama, so this lane supports ZERO held-out-FAMILY answer; the family axis belongs to the sibling experiment.
the_confound_stated_plainly: With only 2 families and three sizes, family label and parameter count NEARLY DETERMINE the three-way class. The family label alone reaches held-out balanced accuracy 0.188 (3-way) and 0.375 (2-way); size alone reaches 0.050 and 0.375. Only 17 of 42 scored metrics beat the family-only baseline. If the family label alone predicts the ground truth as well as the metric does, THE METRIC HAS NOT EARNED ITS FORWARD PASSES.

size_ladder.rungs: Qwen3 at 0.6B, 1.7B and 4B, each with base, instruct and an abliterated sibling -- the one asset this panel has that no other lane does.

ams_row.non_comparable_reason: That protocol held out only the THRESHOLD, not the direction: the direction was fitted on the same 16 contrastive pairs it was then measured on. Our table reports AMS twice -- in its published IN-SAMPLE form (k_ams_sep_insample) and cross-fitted on our folds (k_ams_sep_cf) -- with the gap printed.
ams_row.its_own_headline: AMS's own headline r = -0.546 has a NON-SIGNIFICANT Spearman rho = -0.423 at n = 14; the detectable |rho| at n=14 is 0.543.
ams_row.the_16_author_pairs_are_unreleased: Iteration 1 substituted 16 frozen pairs of its own and said so; that substitution is inherited here unchanged and is a named non-comparability, not a silent one.

lexical_floor_note: delta_over_best_matched_floor is measured against the best MATCHED floor (0.655). The cross-source 0.963 is printed but is explicitly NOT_A_FLOOR: an unmatched safety benchmark is about 96% lexis.
perm_deviation_note: The PREREG fixes B=1000 for the D2 null draws. D3's lineage-clustered permutation p uses B=200 per metric, declared here as a deviation: the test refits a leave-one-lineage-out multinomial logistic model on every permutation for each of 50 metrics, and B=500 keeps the stage inside its time box on a 2-CPU box under heavy shared load. The resulting p has a resolution floor of 1/201.
